## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: Mixed sector returns — Technology, Industrials and Materials led this week while Healthcare, Utilities and Energy lag; Confirmation 2: Large-cap divergences (MSFT, NVDA, AMZN ABOVE TREND vs AAPL BELOW TREND) indicate no clear directional conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: MSFT (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.47% | 1M: +2.48%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: ETN (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing strength: NEM (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +13.12%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -4.87% | 1M: -8.68%) BELOW TREND, SRE (1W: -5.84% | 1M: -11.52%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare soft: UNH (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.08%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -2.82%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate showing weakness: PLD (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -1.32%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5 SP100 performers: AMZN (1W: +15.61% | 1M: +11.76%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.47% | 1M: +2.48%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5, tech-heavy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CVS (1W: -8.55% | 1M: -7.33%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.31%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.08%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -2.82%) BELOW TREND, PLD (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -1.32%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in defensives and select healthcare.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers in SP100: AMZN (1W: +15.61% | 1M: +11.76%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.47% | 1M: +2.48%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence risk: several large caps show 1W vs 1M mismatch (GOOGL, META, TSLA RECOVERY) — MAJOR divergence, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology mixed but leading on the week; MSFT (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.31%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: +7.22% | 1M: -1.15%) RECOVERY — Sector breadth positive this week but internals uneven.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials steady: JPM (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +6.60%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +10.98%) CORRECTION — Financials provide ballast within the NEUTRAL regime.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed/soft: PFE (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +10.85%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.20% | 1M: -1.96%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.08%) BELOW TREND — sector shows pockets of strength but not uniform.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to leaders showing confirmed momentum (MSFT, NVDA, AMZN) and keep Financials exposure (JPM, V) for balance; reduce exposure to lagging defensives and soft healthcare names (AAPL, UNH, CVS). Given MAJOR divergences, treat new entries as tactical until multi-week confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMZN (1W: +15.61% | 1M: +11.76%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.31%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -8.55% | 1M: -7.33%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.08%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (sector 1W: +7.24%) and Industrials (1W: +3.47%) — watch breadth and large-cap confirmation. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -2.72%) and Healthcare (1W: -0.12%) — monitor earnings/guidance flows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: weekly close above recent highs to confirm continuation (ABOVE TREND). AAPL: failure to reclaim 1M support would deepen BELOW TREND risk. MSFT: keep a hold of weekly breakout levels to validate strong 1M trend (ABOVE TREND). JPM: sustained above 1M trend would reinforce Financials leadership (ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+80): Raised 2026 guidance on GLP‑1 demand; LLY (1W: +3.20% | 1M: -1.96%) RECOVERY — sentiment aligns with short-term bounce. PFE not in top news list; PFE (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +10.85%) ABOVE TREND is showing strength but not driven by the headlines listed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (-80): FAA inspections headline; BA (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND — negative news but price rising (divergence/distribution to monitor). QCOM (-55) flagged negative in headlines; price datapoints not in the detailed view — watch pricing for confirmation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; style mixed / no clear leadership. MSFT, NVDA and AMZN showing strength (ABOVE TREND) while AAPL, UNH and CVS show weakness (BELOW TREND). Key risk is MAJOR divergence among large caps and several news-driven divergences (e.g., BA negative headlines but price rising) — monitor for multi-week confirmation.
